summary: Iteration 70 — Scalekit Zoho CRM integration (replaces direct Zoho paste-credentials setup). Backend: new pytest regression test_scalekit_zoho_iter70.py — 19/19 PASS against preview URL. Covers (a) /integrations/scalekit/status connectors == {quickbooks, stripe, zoho}, configured=true, (b) /integrations/scalekit/zoho/start -> readable 400 telling user to create 'zohocrm' connection in Scalekit dashboard, (c) /business/platforms no longer contains zoho + /business/connect/zoho -> 404, (d) /integrations/scalekit/zoho/sync -> 400 'Sync failed: Scalekit 404: connected account not found' (fake demo account ca_100000000000000001), (e) /workspace/status lists zoho + /workspace/targets?provider=zoho -> 200 w/ graceful error, (f) /workspace/actions zoho draft+execute for task/note/call/deal/offer kinds all return 4xx (never 500), persisted status='failed', (g) /workspace/account/{lead_id}?provider=zoho surfaces crm.error, (h) /intent/status destinations.zoho=true + /intent/profiles/{lead}/push zoho graceful 4xx, (i) /outreach/push-crm zoho graceful 4xx, (j) NEW /integrations/scalekit/{connector}/disconnect removes zoho business_connection + synced provider=scalekit deals, returns 404 when not connected and 404 for unsupported connector (bogus) — demo zoho row re-seeded by the test afterwards (verified in DB post-run), (k) Legacy migration: inserted a legacy non-scalekit zoho connection + native synced deal for a fresh user, called /scalekit/zoho/start -> 400 (zohocrm connection missing) BUT legacy row + its synced deals were deleted first (verified). Frontend (preview URL, logged in as testpro@test.com with real credentials): /connect-business renders scalekit-section with cards scalekit-card-quickbooks, scalekit-card-stripe, scalekit-card-zoho; Zoho card shows 'Zoho CRM', 'via Scalekit', 'Two-way sync' badge (scalekit-twoway-zoho), Connected badge (scalekit-connected-zoho), Re-sync button (scalekit-sync-zoho) — click fires toast 'Sync failed: Scalekit 404: connected account not found', and Disconnect icon (scalekit-disconnect-zoho). Disconnect icons also present for stripe + quickbooks (not clicked). Available Platforms list does NOT contain a Zoho CRM paste-credentials card (platform-card-zoho count=0). scalekit-connect-zoho is 0 only because Zoho is currently connected (via Scalekit); the testid is wired in SCALEKIT_CONNECTORS mapping and will render when disconnected.
action_items: No functional issues found in the Scalekit Zoho rework. All backend graceful-error paths and the new disconnect endpoint work as specified; frontend testids all present and the Zoho paste-credentials card has been removed from /connect-business.
critical_code_review_comments: scalekit_integration.CONNECTORS correctly expanded to {quickbooks, stripe, zoho}; LABELS adds Zoho CRM; _CONN_NAMES defaults zoho -> 'zohocrm' (overridable via SCALEKIT_CONNECTION_ZOHO env). _zoho_deals pages through zohocrm_v8_deals_list via Scalekit execute_tool (up to 10 pages of 200). _import_and_store dispatches zoho -> map_zoho_deals. apply_sync('scalekit') scopes the reconcile to provider='scalekit' so direct-native deals are untouched.

scalekit_start RETIRED_DIRECT={zoho} branch deletes any legacy direct zoho business_connection + its native synced deals before attempting Scalekit — verified via a fresh-user test. Good migration path. Note: if the legacy row provider is None, the filter {'provider': {'$ne': 'scalekit'}} still matches, so it works for both None and omitted provider.

scalekit_disconnect returns 404 when nothing to delete (business_connections delete_count=0) and 404 for unsupported connector. Deletes zoho-sourced deals tagged provider='scalekit' only — safe (doesn't nuke manually-created zoho deals that aren't tagged scalekit).
scalekit_sync maps scalekit 404 to a readable 400 'Sync failed: Scalekit 404: connected account not found' — exactly matches review spec.

ConnectBusiness.js SCALEKIT_CONNECTORS adds zoho with the two-way sync description; SETUP_GUIDES.zoho removed (direct paste form retired). handleScalekitDisconnect posts to /integrations/scalekit/{connector}/disconnect and refreshes connections.
crm_auth.zoho now only emits {scalekit_account_id} creds; direct zoho creds (if any residual row) returns a readable error path. This matches the retirement.
Minor: Zoho card text renders 'via Scalekit· Two-way sync' with no space before '·' — tiny visual polish, not a bug.
Latent (pre-existing, flagged in iter69): /app/backend/tests/test_workspace.py still has stale assumptions. Not touched this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testids present + error toast fires)
